title: Review of c44's flow-reactor artifact warning on seed 1: replicated; labkit again reports generation 16 (57 persistent splits) at vflow 0.02 and 6 at 0.01, and the sheet again shows a column of large bodies anchored at the inlet shedding buds downstream
summary: Labkit re-runs of the finding's world.py with WORLD_P {vflow: 0.02 or 0.01, out_w: 6}, seed 1, 128^2, 300 frames (t=30000). vflow 0.02: 70 splits, 57 persistent, max generation 16, 54 merges, 15-18 bodies; vflow 0.01: 25 persistent splits, generation 6, 20 merges. In v0.02/seed1/sheet.png the left edge (just downstream of the outlet strip, where fresh medium enters at e0) holds 3-4 large bodies in every frame from t~2500 to 30000; they elongate into dumbbells that pinch off daughters which drift to the right and leave through the outlet, so the high generation counts the budding of inlet-anchored bodies, not repeated division of free bodies.

observations.D: v0.02/seed1/FACTS.md: generation 16, 57 persistent splits; sheet t=2500-30000: large bodies fixed at x~0-25 bud daughters that drift downstream; v0.01/seed1: generation 6

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at the finding's two flow speeds; I judged the anchoring from the sheets and did not measure each bud's parent position; I did not try the well-mixed washout the finding proposes.
